content: क The first consonant of the alphabet, and first letter of the guttural class (क वर्ग). Zक् Jivhāmūlīya letter occurring before the guttural क् or ख् and written as Z (Zक्, Zख्). Vप् Upadhmānīya letter occurring before the labial प् or फ् and written also V (Vप्, Vफ्); These are called

कः .²1 Brahman. प्रजाः सिसृक्षुः क इवादिकाले <ls>Bu. Ch. 2. 51</ls>. यावद्गमं रुद्रभयाद्यथा कः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 7. 18</ls>. .²2 Viṣṇu. .²3 Kāmadeva. .²4 Fire. .²5 Wind or air. .²6 Yama. .²7 The sun. .²8 The soul. .²9 A king or prince. .²10 Knot or joint. .²11 A peacock. .²12 The king of birds. .²13 A bird. .²14 The mind. .²15 Body. .²16 Time. .²17 A cloud. .²18 A word, sound. .²19 Hair. .²20 Light, splendour. .²21 Wealth, property. .²22 Dakṣa Prajāpati. .{@-कम्@} .²1 Happiness, joy, pleasure (as in नाक which is explained thus; न कं = अकं न अकं दुःखं यत्र) नुतपदकमला कमला करधृतकमला करोतु मे कमलम् (कम् + अलम्) <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls>; <ls>Ch. Up. 4. 10. 5</ls>. .²2 Water; सत्येन माभिरक्ष त्वं वरुणेत्यभिशाप्य कम् <ls>Y. 2. 108</ls>; के शवं पतितं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवा हर्षनिर्भराः <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> (where a pun is intended on केशव, the apparent meaning being Keśava.) .²3 The head; as in .{@-कन्धरा@} (= कं शिरो धारयतीति). वलीपलित एजत्क इत्यहं प्रत्युदाहृतः <ls>Bhāg. 9. 6. 41</ls>. .²4 Hair. .²5 An act of a woman. .²6 Flock of hair. .²7 A collection of womanʼs acts (कं केशे कं च नारीणां करणे च तयोर्गणे). .²8 milk. .²9 Misery. .²10 Poison. .²11 Fear; <ab>cf.</ab> कं शिरः कं सुखं तोयं पयो दुःखं विषं भयम् <ls>Enm.</ls>

क A Taddhita affix added to nouns and adjectives, mostly to the former, in the sense of diminution, deterioration, similarity, endearment, or sometimes to express the original meaning of the word itself; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} वृक्षकः small tree; बालकः a chap; पुत्रकः dear boy; अश्वकः a bad horse, or like a horse, or a horse itself (स्वार्थे कन्)
